rev6.release_notes: Updates: if CAD CAM is still open when G-SEND.IO closes, you are asked to close it, and CAD CAM's update installs. Before, it waited without a word.

cadcam.release_notes: Faster all round: startup without the heavy data libraries, imported parts' checks and holes kept, toolpaths, the turning check and carried stock reused when nothing they read changed, Simulate's playhead and stock, sketch dragging, display meshes, saves and undo, and an idle 3D view that draws nothing. Quick Setup for the lathe: Stock diameter, right-click Save / Restore Setting, a longer step grows the bar; roughing and contour run past the back end when a part-off follows. Sketch ribbon: Chamfer has its own button beside Fillet. Lighter fillet / chamfer edge lines. Simulate: the lathe holder is see-through so the insert shows. Program It: each line's note folds under it. 3D sheet: snaps back from 15 degrees and opens shared pages in Direct View. Z-level finishing: a waterline beside a region's edge comes out as one loop. The generic mill post was removed - pick your machine's post; files that named it still open.
